name: Zachary Warzel
tagline: Top rated Insurance Coverage attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Zachary Warzel is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Denver, Colorado. Zachary Warzel focuses on Insurance Coverage issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff and Appellate.

Zachary Warzel received Super Lawyers designation for 2017 - 2027. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 2005. Before practicing law, he attended law school at Brooklyn Law School and graduated in 2005.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
